credits.title: Summer High
credits.overview: In 1987, two police officers with polar-opposite personalities must team up for the biggest case of their lives when thousands of cans filled with marijuana wash up on Brazilian beaches, threatening to plunge the country into total chaos.

credits.title: Shopping Cart
credits.overview: Ana works at a supermarket where autonomous AI-controlled shopping carts have replaced the staff. Mistreated daily by customers, she forms a bond with the machines. But when a serious accident occurs, Ana realizes the carts are not what they seem.

credits.title: Vozes e Vãos
credits.overview: In the heart of Goiás, young quilombolas reinvent traditions and transform their cultural heritage into strength for the future. "Voices and Gaps" is a sensitive portrait of the resilience and hope of these young people.

credits.title: Valley of Souls
credits.overview: A black family tries to defend their land against invaders but gets caught between a mischievous witch and a tortured spirit eager for revenge.

credits.title: Meio Expediente
credits.overview: After missing out on his co-workers winning lottery pool, the lonely Jairo embarks on an extraordinary Christmas adventure as a helper to none other than Santa Claus himself.

credits.title: Punch the Clock
credits.overview: In a forgotten corner of the vast Brazilian bureaucracy, a psychotic boss uses a time machine to enslave his lazy employees and increase productivity.

credits.title: A Louca História de Andrade Jr.
Nara
credits.overview: Nara shares a little bit of her rich journey.

credits.title: Enciclopédia do Inusitado e do Irracional
credits.overview: A long-time library employee is fired from the job he had held for many years. His world collapses, and he vows revenge.

credits.title: Nada Consta
credits.overview: The story takes place in Brasília, year 2017, under the Robotic World Government. Randau do Congo Naya intends do get to the Moon for his marriage, but faces political and bureaucratic problems.

credits.title: A Vingança da Bibliotecária
credits.overview: A librarian's strategies for silencing noisy readers are shown with horror and comedy. The setting and suspense guarantee the entertainment value of this horror short film full of frightening images.
